public final class DoubleEngine extends Engine implements Activatable
Represents a double engine component. They implement the Activatable interface to manage their power state.

  • Method Details

    • getEnginePower

      public int getEnginePower()
      Gets the total engine power provided by this double engine. When activated, it provides double the normal power of a standard engine.
      Overrides:
      getEnginePower in class Engine
      Returns:
      2 if facing down and activated, or normal engine power (i.e., 0) if not activated
